item.title: Nifty-500 clocks highest earnings growth in 8 quarters
item.description: Mumbai: India Inc delivered its strongest earnings performance in the past eight quarters in the third quarter of FY26, driven by broad-based sectoral growth and improving demand trends, a new report said on Sunday.The data compiled by Motilal Oswal Financial Services said that aggregate earnings of the Nifty 500 universe rose 19 per cent year-on-year in 3QFY26. item.title: Rs 3.4 crore ATM fraud unearthed in Hassan
item.description: Hassan: A major financial irregularity has surfaced in Hassan district after more than ₹3 crore meant for ATM replenishment allegedly went missing from a private cash management agency. item.title: Happy over Kharge’s assurance on resolving leadership issue: DKS
item.description: Deputy Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar on Saturday said he was happy over AICC President Mallikarjun Kharge’s assurance to senior Congress leader Satish Jarkiholi regarding resolving the leadership issue in the state.

item.title: ‘Raakshasa’ review: A hollow remake that butchers a proven thriller
item.description: Raakshasa, the Kannada adaptation of the acclaimed Tamil series Vilangu, turns out to be a deeply disappointing exercise in wasted potential. Despite a promising premise and the presence of Vijay Raghavendra in the lead role, the series collapses under weak storytelling, poor execution, and a baffling inability to understand what made the original work. item.title: Motherson Group eyes $108-bn revenues by 2030
item.description: Motherson Group remains on course to achieve its target of 108 billion in revenue by 2030, according to Chairman Vivek Chaand Sehgal.
